subject: OCCURS clause
notes: Rule (cite.py OK §13.18.38.4 4)): 'The value of integer-2 represents the fixed number of occurrences of the subject of the entry.' Code: FieldInit emits a C# array of exactly item.Occurs (= integer-2) element initializers; CobolTable.At bounds occurrences to 1..table.Length. Probes: gr1.cob group T of five OCCURS 3 tables images as 3 occurrences each; gr14b.cob a fixed OCCURS 2 table raises EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT for occurrence 5 (the fixed count is the highest permissible occurrence number). Constant-name bound (§13.10.3 SR2) accepted per the grammar's integerOperand (the OCCURS bound: an integer literal or a constant-name). No spec-derived golden asserts the occurrence count of a Format 1 table as such (char_occurs is characterization only) -> test-needed. || Editions (adjudicator's statement, normalized to 85,2002,2014,2023 by registrar 14e): 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023
